title: TopoFisher: Learning Topological Summary Statistics by Maximizing Fisher Information
summary: Persistence diagrams provide stable, interpretable summaries of geometric and topological structure and are useful for simulation-based inference when low-order statistics miss key information. Yet persistence-based pipelines require hand-chosen filtrations, vectorizations, and compressors, typically without an objective tied to parameter uncertainty. We introduce \textbf{TopoFisher}, a differentiable persistent-homology pipeline that learns topological summaries by maximizing local Gaussian Fisher information.
